links.note: Was on 32929 Joint Families and Nuclear Families, which is about family types. What families provide - love, care, cooperation and interdependence, and the learning of traditions and values - is 32931's content, and complete isolation is what it rules out.

Was on 32940 Community as a Flexible Word. The false pair is halma as individual problem solving, and 32936 defines halma as the Bhil tradition of coming together to support any individual or family in times of crisis.

Was on 32934 Tenzing's Household in Meghalaya, one worked example. The general claim is 32931's - as children grow up they take on more responsibilities in the home, and through daily practice they learn to participate in the life of the household.
Was on 32940 Community as a Flexible Word. The Shivganga movement, Shri Mahesh Sharma and the Bhil communities of Jhabua are all in 32936.

Was on 32940 Community as a Flexible Word. The reasons communities gather - festivals, feasts, weddings and other events, and in villages land preparation, sowing and harvesting - are listed in 32935, against which individual isolation is the outlier.

Was on 32929 Joint Families and Nuclear Families. Families coming together for festivals, feasts and weddings, and what those gatherings do for the ties between them, is 32935's account of what makes a community.
